body: This is a pre-existing problem, but you can actually simplify this by using the new `resize_initialized` function and then the manual zero-filling can be removed.

Thanks @aaronfranke. Regarding manual-zero filling, I used the same logic as the existing code for custom attributes, i.e. the use of `resize` followed manual zero-filling, and even the comment that explains why. I agree with you that `resize_initialized` is better, so I updated and cleaned up the code that follows too without changing its behavior (code that wasn't added by this PR).

I amended the existing commit and force-pushed my changes. I hope that's the correct workflow. It's been a while since I last committed to Godot.
